title: Hambone
body:
The Hambone is a decorative item that is no longer able to be purchased. It was added November 11, 2023, for the 2023 Thanksgiving event. It was able to be purchased from the Oak Depot for $250. It has a prompt to "Compliment Ham" which upon activating plays a line from The Simpsons, Season 7, Episode 21, "22 Short Films About Springfield"[1] or more specifically the "Steamed Hams" segment. It plays a line from the short where Superintendent Chalmers says the line of: "Well, Seymour, you are an odd fellow but I must say you steam a good ham."

  1. ↑ https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/22_Short_Films_About_Springfield
